title: Briefing
empty: You have not published a briefing yet. Write what the supplier has to do, when, where and who they talk to.

hints.what: What the supplier has to do.
hints.when: The day and the times: arrival, set-up, programme.
hints.where: The address and the exact spot.
hints.contacts: Who they call on the day.

status.acked: Version {version} is acknowledged by the supplier
status.waiting: The supplier has the link; we are waiting for the acknowledgement.
status.needsLink: Generate the supplier link (below) and send it, so they can acknowledge.
status.noAckYet: The supplier has not acknowledged this version.

editor.title: Briefing — version {version}
editor.introFirst: Once published, a version is never edited. If something changes, you publish a new version and the supplier sees what changed.
editor.introNext: You start from the published version. The old version stays as it is, and the supplier sees what differs and acknowledges again.

errors.empty: The briefing is empty. Write at least what the supplier has to do.
errors.unchanged: You changed nothing compared with the published version.
errors.ackName: Write your name, so the planner knows who acknowledged.
errors.linkGone: This link is no longer valid. Ask the planner for a new one.

gone.title: This link is not valid.
gone.body: It may have been replaced or withdrawn. Ask the planner for a new link.

link.dateUndecided: The date is not decided yet
link.noBriefing: The planner has not published a briefing yet. Come back to this link later.
link.changedTitle: What changed since version {version}, which you acknowledged
link.ackIntro: Read version {version} above. When everything is clear, acknowledge it.
link.ackNameHint: The planner sees who acknowledged and when.
link.ackSubmit: I have received and understood the briefing
link.cancelledBody: For details, get in touch with the planner.
link.postponedBody: The planner will tell you the new date. The briefing below may change.
link.footer: Private page, for this booking only. Do not pass it on.

pdf.exportDescription: The date, the venue, the programme of the day, the suppliers with their latest briefing, the deliveries and the guest count. No guest list and no amounts.
pdf.subject: Occasion briefing
pdf.dateUndecided: The date is not decided yet
pdf.programmeEmpty: Nothing in the programme of the day.
pdf.notAcknowledged: Not acknowledged by the supplier yet.
